title: Enrollment tokens
subtitle: Single-use, named tokens for the mTLS enrollment of a new agent.

procedure.title: Enrollment procedure (3 steps)
procedure.body: 1. Generate a named token (15 min TTL recommended). 2. Drop the token on the target server and start the agent. 3. The agent sends a CSR, the API signs it with its internal CA, and the agent automatically appears as active.
